She did not know whether to feel afraid or chosen, but the keeper in her understood that some messages arrive only after years of travel.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。街道褪去白日喧嚣，只有路灯垂着昏黄的光，把梧桐叶影铺在湿柏油路上。便利店亮着温暖的玻璃，飘出咖啡香气；环卫车缓缓驶过，带起一片落叶。远处高架偶有车灯划过，像无声的鱼。江边雾气渐起，轮渡尚未鸣笛。风穿过楼群，带来微弱潮声。整座城市屏住呼吸，等待第一班地铁与天光苏醒。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem uses a smaller version of itself to find an answer.\n- Each smaller version keeps shrinking until it reaches a simple stopping case.\n- Then the small answers pass back up, layer by layer, to solve the original problem."}
